content.user_title: Configure Detox Tests on Limrun iOS
content.value_statement: Detox setup on remote iOS simulators requires aligned mediator, tunnel, and session settings. This skill provides a repeatable workflow for configuration, validation, and troubleshooting.
actual_capabilities: Explains the mediator, tester, and app client roles in a Limrun Detox session.
Provides a three-terminal workflow for the Detox server, Limrun tunnel, and test runner.
Shows how to connect Detox session environment variables in a project configuration.
Describes the Limrun third-party Detox driver configuration for an iOS simulator.
Lists connection signals and focused troubleshooting steps for common mediator errors.
Explains cleanup commands for manual tunnel and simulator test runs.
limitations: It does not build, sign, or prepare a native iOS application unless requested separately.
It requires a configured Limrun instance, compatible Detox package, and project test setup.
It does not replace the official Limrun or Detox documentation for product-specific behavior.
It cannot diagnose failures without relevant command output, logs, and project configuration details.

use_cases.title: Start a first remote Detox run
use_cases.description: Set up the mediator, destination tunnel, tester, and app launch sequence for a Limrun iOS simulator.

use_cases.title: Connect an existing test project
use_cases.description: Adapt a Detox configuration to use the Limrun driver and align its session variables.

use_cases.title: Resolve a connection failure
use_cases.description: Check app and tester connection states, tunnel status, and visible UI when a manual run fails.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Set up a test run
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me run my existing Detox tests on a Limrun iOS simulator. List the required terminals and commands.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Configure Detox
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to configure my Detox project for a Limrun iOS device. My Detox version is [version].

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Debug connectivity
prompt_templates.prompt: My Detox mediator reports that it cannot forward to the client. Help me verify tunnel, app, and tester connection order.

prompt_templates.title: Expert: Review a test workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Limrun Detox workflow for session alignment, supported Detox version, and safe cleanup steps: [details].

output_examples.input: Help me start Detox on a Limrun simulator.
output: A three-terminal launch sequence for the mediator, tunnel, and tester.
The required session variables and app launch parameters.
Validation signals that confirm the app and tester are connected.

output_examples.input: My test runner cannot connect to the app.
output: A checklist for mediator logs, tunnel status, and session ID alignment.
An explanation of expected connection-order messages.
Safe cleanup steps before retrying the run.

best_practices: Start the Detox tester before launching the app so the mediator has a connected client.
Keep Detox server and session values identical across the tester, configuration, and app launch.
Use explicit simulator IDs and clean up obsolete tunnels after manual test runs.
anti_patterns: Do not pass arbitrary environment variables, application arguments, or injectable paths to the app launcher.
Do not assume Detox automatically consumes Limrun session variables without project configuration.
Do not treat an idle tunnel as evidence that a simulator test instance is active.

faq.question: What does this skill configure?
faq.answer: It configures the connection between Detox, a Limrun iOS simulator, and the Limrun Detox driver.

faq.question: Do I need separate terminals?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow uses separate terminals for the mediator, tunnel, and tester.

faq.question: Which Detox session values matter?
faq.answer: The Detox server URL and session ID must match across configuration, test execution, and app launch.

faq.question: Can this skill build my iOS app?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on Detox runtime setup and debugging, not native build preparation.

faq.question: Why does the mediator report it cannot forward?
faq.answer: This can occur when the app connects before the tester. Start the tester first or wait for it to connect.

faq.question: Does the skill manage the iOS lifecycle?
faq.answer: No. Prepare or reuse the Limrun simulator separately from the Detox workflow.
